hero.headline: Turn your garage into a fully finished ADU.
hero.subhead: Dream Haven Construction plans and builds ADU, kitchen, and bathroom projects the way an engineer would: feasibility first, permits handled properly, and a schedule you can actually hold us to.

contact.address: 930 Palm Ave, Unit 301, West Hollywood, CA 90069

services.sectionSub: Every project runs through the same discipline: real feasibility review, coordinated engineering, and a general contractor who is on the job — not just estimating it.

items.title: ADUs & Garage Conversions
items.description: Turnkey garage-to-ADU conversions that add livable square footage, rental income, or equity — designed around your lot and your goals, never a generic floor plan.
items.imageAlt: ADU exterior with cedar siding at dusk

items.title: Kitchen Remodeling
items.description: Full gut-and-rebuild kitchens: layout changes, load-bearing wall removals, panel upgrades, relocated plumbing and electrical, cabinetry and finish coordination.
items.imageAlt: Kitchen remodel with sage green cabinetry

items.title: Bathroom Remodeling
items.description: Waterproofing done correctly, efficient plumbing rework, and finish-level detailing — from a single-fixture refresh to a complete reconfiguration.
items.imageAlt: Bathroom remodel with gold fixtures and soaking tub

items.title: Structural Modifications
items.description: Load-bearing wall removals, beam sizing coordination, and structural repairs — always run past a licensed structural engineer before a wall comes down.

items.title: Design & Permit Coordination
items.description: Architectural drawings, engineering coordination, and city approvals handled from the start — so the permit is right the first time and the design actually works for how you'll use the space.

items.title: Whole-Home Renovation
items.description: Multi-room and whole-house projects that need one contractor holding the permits, the trades, and the schedule together from start to final sign-off.

process.sectionSub: Four stages, in this order, every time — so you always know what's next.

items.title: Confirm feasibility
items.description: We walk the property, understand your goals, and confirm what's genuinely possible before anything is priced.

items.title: Plans & approvals
items.description: We coordinate drawings, engineering, and city approvals so the permit is right the first time.

items.title: Organized execution
items.description: A clear schedule, coordinated trades, and consistent updates. No guessing where things stand.

items.title: Signed off, done right
items.description: Final inspection and close-out, so the work is code-compliant and ready to use — not just finished.

adu.sectionSub: A turnkey conversion product with fixed tiers, so pricing conversations start from a real number instead of a guess.
adu.note: Pricing reflects the Standard finish at each tier; Premium is available on all three sizes. Final pricing depends on site conditions, utility distance, and finish selections, and is confirmed after a walkthrough.

why.sectionSub: We don't compete on being the cheapest bid. We compete on the projects that have to be done correctly.

items.title: Engineering-first solutions
items.description: Structural work is coordinated with licensed engineers and architects before it is ever priced — not improvised mid-build.

items.title: Licensed & insured
items.description: CSLB #1127356, with hands-on experience across electrical, plumbing, drywall, and finish work.

items.title: Honest, direct communication
items.description: Clear scopes, realistic timelines, and no surprises. You'll know what's happening and why.

items.title: One point of contact
items.description: The owner handles estimating, permitting, and project management personally — never handed off to a call center.

vision.sectionTitle: Remodeling is the starting point, not the end goal
vision.sectionSub: Dream Haven is built to grow from remodeling into a full design-build and real estate development company — the same standards, applied to larger projects, over time.

gallery.sectionSub: Drag the handle on a comparison to see where the project started. More before/after sets are added as current jobs wrap.

footer.description: Licensed California General Contractor specializing in kitchen, bathroom, and ADU remodeling across Los Angeles and Southern California.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience working with Ayman and Dream Haven Construction on our kitchen renovation. Ayman handled all of the construction and renovation work, and we couldn't be happier with the results. From the beginning, Ayman was professional, dependable, responsive, and very attentive to the details.
reviews.name: Cheryl Scott

reviews.text: I had a great experience working with Ayman on a kitchen remodeling project. He is an honest, responsible, and professional general contractor who always arrives on time and keeps everything organized and on schedule.
reviews.name: Andrei Den

reviews.text: Ayman is amazing! He is on time, brings everything he needs, and explains the job. I learned more about my kitchen appliances than I knew before! Great work on electrical also. Plumbing and walls also handled like a pro. Highly recommend this company!!
reviews.name: Christel Hachigian

reviews.text: I recently had a kitchen remodeling and used Dream Haven Construction for some of the work. I am very happy with the results and the professionalism that Ayman showed.
reviews.name: Sofia Sosa

reviews.text: Very thoughtful and caring work. He went out of the way to find parts that weren't entirely needed and did it with grace. Great job all around! Highly recommend for appliance install and set up!
reviews.name: Scott Olsen

reviews.text: Great contractor. Knows what he's doing. My job looks great.
reviews.name: William Preston
